page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable instructions attached to your agents' prompts.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Write one from scratch, or import it from a file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to view or edit it.

card.vettingTitle: Untrusted source — review and trust before enabling

detail.runOnEvalsHint: Available once the Evals tab ships.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface. Write it as a directive: Use when… Flags…
config.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
config.changeNoteHint: Optional. Stored with the new version.
config.draftBanner: Draft from v{version}. Nothing is saved until you press Save, which creates a new version.
config.draftUnavailable: v{version} body unavailable, so the editor shows the current version.

dirtyGuard.title: Discard changes?
dirtyGuard.body: This skill has unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

preview.title: Preview
preview.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.commentWarning: This body contains HTML comments, hidden from the rendered view.
preview.invisibleWarning: This body contains invisible or bidirectional characters, marked below.

vet.title: Review & trust
vet.body: "{name}" came from an untrusted source. Read its body below before you enable it — once enabled, it becomes part of your agents' prompts.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a reusable instruction attached to one or more agents.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import a skill from a Markdown file or a zip archive.
drawer.trustBanner: This is someone else's instructions. Once enabled, it goes into your agent's prompt.
drawer.chooseFileHint: Markdown (.md) or a zip (.zip) archive, up to 1 MB.

errors.noSkillMd: No SKILL.md found at the archive root or one level deep.
errors.bomb: Archive expands past 5 MB once decompressed.
errors.badUtf8: SKILL.md is not valid UTF-8 text.

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the file name when the file has no frontmatter.
file.bodyHint: Imported skills start disabled and unvetted — review the body before you enable them.
file.success: Imported "{name}". It stays disabled until you review and trust it.
